description: Arc launchpad fee vaults: every vault holding USDC now, its creator and token, and how much it changed since our previous scan. Fees only accrue from real swaps. $0.025 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: arc_fee_flow
